info.description: Read-only REST API exposing Shopify partner metrics, App Store rankings, reviews and traffic analytics for the apps a Ranksy team tracks. Ranksy is the SaaS that Shopify app developers use to observe their apps; this API serves the same data programmatically.

parameters.name: basis
parameters.description:
Period basis for basis-keyed metrics (e.g. ltv → monthly_ltv |
yearly_ltv); ignored by other metrics. Per-metric default + the
unsupported-basis guard live in GetMetricForApi. The allow-list
is the union across basis-keyed metrics — extend as future

parameters.name: window
parameters.description:
Rolling window for the windowed rate metrics `churn_rate` and
`revenue_churn_rate` (a frozen daily rolling snapshot); selects
which stored PMD churn column to read. One of 7d, 30d, 90d, 365d;
defaults to 30d. Ignored by non-windowed metrics. Example: 90d.

empty allow-list so callers get a clear 422 rather than silent
ignoring. Widened in later milestones (e.g. group_by=plan).

get.description:
The app's current monthly recurring revenue, a **money** metric reported in the app's base payout currency (the `currency` key).

- **Snapshot** (no date range): the latest stored MRR; today's value is recomputed live before the daily snapshot writes.
- **Series** (`start_date`/`end_date`): MRR is a *stock* (a level), so each bucket reports the value as of the bucket's last day — never summed.

No `components`. A `currency` param is acknowledged in metadata only — values are never converted from the base currency.

get.description:
Transaction revenue in the app's base payout currency. A **money breakdown** metric: `value` is **gross** revenue (total transaction value before Shopify's revenue share) and `components` carries `{ gross, net }`, where net is after Shopify's cut.

A *flow* metric: week/month buckets SUM `value` and every component. Carries the base-currency `currency` code.

get.description:
The dashboard's live, plan-aware **estimated LTV** (current ARPU ÷ 30-day churn rate), computed live — never the lagging stored columns. A **money** metric (base-currency `currency`).

- `basis` = `month` (default) or `year` (the monthly figure annualised, ×12).
- `excluded_plans` removes plans from the calculation (comma-separated, or repeated `excluded_plans[]`), exactly like the dashboard LTV page.
- LTV is a point-in-time *level* computed as-of-now; a series stamps that current value on each bucket and never sums.

No `components`. Returns **400** `invalid_basis` for an unsupported basis.

get.description:
Net revenue retention, cohort-anchored and reported **monthly** (reuses the dashboard NRR computation). Value is a **fraction** (1.10 = 110%).

`components`: `{ mrr_retained, mrr_base }` — MRR amounts in the app's base payout currency. The `value` itself is dimensionless, so there is no top-level `currency` key.

- **Snapshot**: the trailing-12-month cohort NRR (`metadata.window` = `12mo`).
- **Series**: one point per month over the requested range; the `granularity` param has no effect (NRR is always monthly).

get.description:
Share of trials that convert to a paid subscription, cohort-anchored on the **trial-start date** (matches the dashboard + MCP). Value is a **fraction** (0.30 = 30%), not a percentage.

`value` = `trials_converted / trials_started`. The denominator is **settled** trials only — converted + cancelled. Trials still running are excluded: they have no outcome yet, so counting them as non-conversions would understate every recent cohort and make the number drift upward for months as those trials end.

`components`: `{ trials_converted, trials_started }` — the raw inputs behind `value`. The cohort's `trials_started` and still-running `trials_active` are in `metadata`, not `components`, because they are not part of the ratio.

`provisional`: `true` while the measured cohort still has trials running, so the value can still move. When `provisional` is `true` and `trials_started` is `0`, nothing has ended yet and the `0` value carries **no signal** — do not render it as a 0% conversion rate. Series points carry their own `provisional` flag per bucket.

- **Snapshot**: the trailing-30-day start cohort (`metadata.window` = `30d`), measured over the trials in it that have since ended.
- **Series**: week/month buckets SUM the raw counts then divide — daily rates are never averaged.

get.description:
Rolling **logo churn** rate — the canonical "real churn" calc shared with the dashboard, frozen daily into a snapshot keyed on the Shopify event date (`metadata.computed` = `stored`). Value is a **fraction** (0.125 = 12.5%).

- `window` = `7d` | `30d` (default) | `90d` | `365d` selects the rolling window.
- `basis` = `real_churn` (the only basis in v1).
- `components`: `{ customers_churned, customers_at_risk }` — present **only** for the default 30d window; other windows store the rate alone and omit `components`.
- Overlapping windows are never summed: series buckets take the value as of the bucket's last day.

Returns **400** `unsupported_basis` for any basis other than `real_churn`.

with start_date/end_date (which select a series); supplying both
is a 422. Omit all three for the latest value.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description:
Aggregation bucket size for a series response. 'day' is the
native PMD grain; week/month are rolled up by GetMetricForApi.

parameters.name: basis
parameters.description: Churn basis. v1 supports `real_churn` only (the default).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description:
Rolling window for the windowed rate metrics `churn_rate` and
`revenue_churn_rate` (a frozen daily rolling snapshot); selects
which stored PMD churn column to read. One of 7d, 30d, 90d, 365d;
defaults to 30d. Ignored by non-windowed metrics. Example: 90d.

400.description: **400 `unsupported_basis`** — the `basis` query param was set to something other than `real_churn`, the only churn basis v1 supports. Omit `basis` (it defaults to `real_churn`) or pass `basis=real_churn`; anything else is rejected with `error.param` = `basis`. This is the only 400 this endpoint returns.

403.description: insufficient_permissions — the key lacks the required scope.

409.description: **409** — this metric depends on the app's Shopify Partner integration, which isn't usable yet. `error.code` is one of: `partner_integration_not_connected` (no Partner API integration has ever been connected for this app), `partner_integration_unauthorized` (the stored Partner credentials were revoked or rejected — reconnect the integration in Ranksy), or `partner_integration_pending` (the first partner sync is still running — retry once it completes). Partner metrics keep returning 409 until the integration is connected and has synced at least once.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. See the Retry-After header.

post.description:
Works two ways. Token path: send `shopify_access_token` and Ranksy pulls
store metadata (plan, address, timezone) from the Shopify Admin API.
Data path: send `shop_id` plus a flat `shop` object and Ranksy stores it
directly with no outbound call. Either path also persists contacts, tags,
and custom fields per-installation.
post.summary: Identify and enrich a merchant's CRM record

installAttributed}) and the `outrankedTrackedCount` /
`unrankedTrackedCount` totals.

reviews_reputation.description:
Reviews & reputation sub-score (0–100) plus its breakdown:
`rating` ({score, maxScore:35, value, competitorAvg}), `volume`
({score, maxScore:20, count, competitorAvg}), `sentiment` ({score,
maxScore:25, positiveRatio, distribution:{positive,neutral,negative}}),
`recency` ({score, maxScore:20}) and the `competitorAdjustment`
integer (-5..+5).

visibility.description:
Visibility sub-score (0–100) plus its breakdown:
`categoriesRankedIn` ({score, maxScore:25, count,
categories:[{name, rank}]}), `bestPosition` ({score, maxScore:30,
position}), `avgPosition` ({score, maxScore:25, position}) and
`categoryGaps` ({score, maxScore:20, gaps}).

is_provisional.description:
True when the scorecard was computed against a PROVISIONAL comparison
set (embedding-similar → top-category apps) because the team follows
no competitors yet.

computed_at.description: When the scorecard was last computed (ISO-8601), or null if never.

improvement_opportunities.description:
Prioritised improvement opportunities (priority 1 = highest first).
Each item: `type` (listing_quality|keyword_performance|
reviews_reputation|visibility), `message`, `priority` (int),
`current_value` / `target_value` (string|int|null), `link_to`
(string|null), and optionally `keywords` (a list of
{keyword, tracked, installAttributed} chips on keyword items).

examples.message: Competitors outrank you on 4 keywords you track: stock alerts, low stock. Improve your listing relevance for these.
Your app details field is significantly underutilized. This is the most impactful field for conversions.

competitor_comparison.description:
Head-to-head comparison against each followed competitor (empty when
none are followed). Each item: `id`, `name`, `slug`, `logo_url`, a
`metrics` map (rating|reviews|keywords|categories|estInstalls →
{yours, theirs, winner:"you"|"them"|"tie"}) and `winsCount` (0–5).

shopify_access_token.description: Token path (unchanged prefix rule) — now optional.

shop_id.description: Data path — a positive numeric id or a Shop GID string.

shop.description: Data-path shop object — flat, snake_case, Ranksy column names. All optional.

shopify_access_token.description:
Merchant Admin API token (shop-scoped) — used by /identify-style
enrichment. NOT used to forward App Events (Shopify 401s it).

app_events_token.description:
App-level JWT the app mints from its Dev Dashboard client credentials
(client_credentials grant) — the ONLY token Shopify's App Events API
accepts. App-scoped, ~60 min lifetime; the app refreshes + reuses it
across all its shops. We forward with this and never persist it.

attributes.description:
Whole array only — do NOT add an `attributes.value` rule: a nested
rule makes validated() prune `attributes` to just that key, dropping
every other attribute. The numeric value is validated leniently in
RecordCustomAppEvent (is_numeric → float, else null).

idempotency_key.description:
Optional client-supplied idempotency (Shopify App Events API shape);
custom events dedupe on these, else the server generates them.

status.description: Subscription status (active | cancelled | declined | expired | frozen).

amount.description: Recurring charge amount in the subscription's currency.

billing_interval.description: Billing interval as reported by Shopify (e.g. EVERY_30_DAYS / ANNUAL), or null.

activated_at.description: When the subscription was activated (ISO-8601), or null.

cancelled_at.description: When the subscription was cancelled (ISO-8601), or null when still active.
